annual.title: India annual oil trade
annual.description: PPAC import/export history, FY1998-99 to FY2024-25, thousand tonnes: crude, product imports and exports, LPG imports, and diesel, petrol, jet, naphtha and fuel oil exports.

suppliers.title: Crude suppliers to India
suppliers.description: Crude imports by supplier, million b/d, July–September 2026. Kpler ship-tracking as reported by Business Standard and ThePrint; July–August 'All other' is the PPAC total less Russia; September 'Others' is Kpler's ~5.3 mb/d total less named suppliers.

import_bill.title: Import bill in rupees
import_bill.description: PPAC customs value of crude imports, product imports and product exports, ₹ crore, April–September 2026 (earlier months revised), with the Mumbai Port Authority monthly rupee-dollar rate; September uses the rate implied by PPAC's rupee and dollar files.

scenarios.title: Model output by scenario
scenarios.description: India-wide product output, thousand tonnes a month at 5.3 mb/d of crude runs, from the India Refinery Yield Simulator for five crude mixes: July 2026, September 2026, and three no-Russia cases. Illustrations, not forecasts.

grade_yields.title: Model yields by refiner
grade_yields.description: Indicative light-product and diesel yield, % of crude by weight, for nine crude grades at each refiner's equipment mix. From the India crude yield model (published assays, standard unit yields); runs 2–5 points high.

monthly.title: India monthly oil trade 2026
monthly.description: PPAC provisional import/export of crude and products, April–September 2026 (thousand tonnes, file to September 2026 with earlier months revised), with crude in million b/d at 7.33 bbl/t and the month's Brent share of the Indian Crude Basket. August–September use pro-rated customs data.

demand.title: Product demand by region
demand.description: PPAC original estimate of FY2026-27 consumption by region, thousand tonnes: LPG, petrol, diesel and jet fuel.

quality.title: Crude and basket quality
quality.description: API gravity and sulfur for benchmark grades (Platts Periodic Table of Oil, Sep 2026) and for three baskets: pre-war 20/80 and paper 65/35 (production-weighted Brent and Dubai/Oman basket grades) and the estimated September 2026 mix.

refiners.title: Indian refiners
refiners.description: Refining capacity at 1 April 2026 (PPAC) for the five largest groups, and the share of each group's capacity that is simple, cracking or full conversion by Nelson complexity.

basket_ratio.title: Basket Brent share
basket_ratio.description: Dated Brent share of the Indian Crude Basket (rest Dubai/Oman): annual weights FY2000-01 to FY2025-26 from PPAC, monthly from March 2026 per the Ministry order of 26 March 2026 and PPAC notifications.

full_conversion_slate.title: Full-conversion product slate
full_conversion_slate.description: Indicative product slate at a full-conversion refinery, % of crude by weight, for nine grades, from the India crude yield model.

accuracy.title: Model vs PPAC yields
accuracy.description: PPAC reported distillate yield for IOC refineries against the yield model's estimate with Gulf sour crude.

basket_price.title: Indian Crude Basket price
basket_price.description: PPAC monthly average FOB price of the Indian Crude Basket, US$/bbl, April 2018 to October 2026 (October month to date, table posted 28 October 2026).

gas.title: Gas supply, August
gas.description: PPAC monthly gas report: production, LNG imports and gas available for sale, August 2025 and August 2026, million standard cubic metres.

product_prices.title: Diesel, petrol and crude prices
product_prices.description: PPAC international FOB prices used for Indian pricing: diesel, petrol and the Indian Crude Basket, US$/bbl monthly averages, April 2018 to October 2026 (October month to date, tables posted 28 October 2026).

range_long.title: Monthly series, 2021–2026
range_long.description: Monthly values by calendar month for India's crude imports (million b/d at 7.33 bbl/t), product exports and imports (thousand tonnes) from PPAC import/export files (FY2020-21 to FY2025-26 plus FY2026-27 to September), and the Indian basket price and diesel and petrol cracks over the basket (US$/bbl) from PPAC international price tables, January 2021 to October 2026.
